info.title: Thoth API
info.description: Build-time generated OpenAPI document for the Thoth API. It is assembled from the shared Zod endpoint and entity schemas, then committed to `public/openapi.json` for static serving.

post.summary: Reorder a page within its sibling group

get.summary: Reconstruct a page revision and diff it against the current state

post.summary: Restore the current page to a historical revision
Create a new page seeded from a historical revision
Connect an app to a page

delete.summary: Disconnect an app from a page

get.summary: List soft-deleted pages, data sources, and views
Get a workspace's uploaded-file storage usage
Get platform capabilities for the current user

sessionCookie.name: thoth-auth.session_token
sessionCookie.description: Better Auth session cookie. In production this is prefixed with __Secure- (i.e. __Secure-thoth-auth.session_token).

bearerApiKey.description: App API key sent as Authorization: Bearer <key>.
